coordination.overlap_check: No open PR matching the Claude adapter toolless/ephemeral/structured/env-isolation split was found before the branch write. Active current PRs were concentrated on J-Space/boot/runtime ancestry and the retained reference-runtime lane.

source_discriminator.finding: The monolithic red test itself depended on two ambient host states unrelated to the security semantics it intended to measure.

ambient_dependencies.name: HOME
ambient_dependencies.before: test asserted HOME exists in the subprocess environment but did not set/bind HOME itself
ambient_dependencies.after: test creates a tmp_path-local home directory, sets HOME explicitly, and asserts exact equality

ambient_dependencies.name: shell_sentinel
ambient_dependencies.before: test used the fixed global path /tmp/SHOULD_NOT_EXIST and asserted that it did not exist
ambient_dependencies.after: test uses a unique tmp_path-local sentinel and asserts that this exact per-test path is not created

source_discriminator.implication: A persistent red bit could be produced by pre-existing host state or absent HOME even when ClaudeCodeInference remained shell=False, tool-less, schema-constrained and secret-isolated. This does not prove that either ambient dependency caused the historical red; it proves the old test could not cleanly distinguish those host-state cases from an adapter boundary defect.
source_discriminator.counterhypothesis_retained: A real adapter defect may still exist. The split tests are designed to localize it without weakening any boundary.

test_changes: replace the monolithic adapter boundary node with four independently addressable receipt nodes
TOOLLESS receipt binds -p, permission-mode plan, tools empty, strict MCP and shell-sentinel non-creation
EPHEMERAL receipt binds max-turns=1, no-session-persistence, prompt-history suppression and explicit test HOME
STRUCTURED_OUTPUT receipt binds normalized response plus the exact effect capability enum
ENV_ISOLATION receipt binds Claude auth preservation and Clerk/database secret exclusion
remove unbound dependency on global /tmp residue and ambient HOME presence

next_gate: Run the exact branch bytes in an actually-started authorized isolated executor.
Bind full commit/tree, test blob, adapter blob, executor identity, Python/pytest versions and exact failing node if any.
If all four receipt nodes pass, rerun the full suite before classifying the historical single red as fixed/test-metrology-related.
If one node fails, classify only that phase and preserve the others as independent evidence; do not weaken the adapter contract.
